classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, providing sanitized access to request data such as GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER variables within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object by sanitizing and storing global PHP request variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sanitized GET request parameter, optionally cast to a specified type.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Retrieves a sanitized POST request parameter, optionally cast to a specified type.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Recursively sanitizes input data by trimming and converting special HTML characters.
